annotations.title: Make a new EINI meal plan

description: Make a NEW weekly meal plan (lunch and dinner, 7 days) in the user's EINI account, built around this week's Swiss supermarket deals, with its shopping list. Uses the user's saved EINI settings (people, diets, stores); you may change people, diets or language. Call it only when the user asks for a new plan: the new plan becomes their current plan in the app (earlier plans are not deleted). The account may need an EINI subscription for it (the answer says so). Needs the user's EINI login.

adults.description: Optional. Adults eating; default: the user's saved setting.

children.description: Optional. Children eating; default: the user's saved setting.

diet.description: Optional. Replaces the saved diets; [] for none.

language.description: Optional. Language of recipes and shopping list; default: saved.

name: eini_create_meal_plan
title: Make a new EINI meal plan
